 Women's Champions League - Game Week 4 10 Nov 2026 - 14:00 Stadio Brianteo Disney+ will show Inter vs Manchester City Women live. Details on how to watch are below.
 At the Stadio Brianteo in Monza, Inter host Manchester City Women in a Women's Champions League match that could shape both teams' European ambitions.
 Inter arrive on the back of a good league run. David Sassarini's side beat AC Milan 3-0 in their last Serie A Femminile fixture, underlining the defensive solidity that has defined their season. The Women's Champions League, though, presents a much tougher test.
 Having faced recent challenges in the WSL, Andree Jeglertz's Manchester City Women responded by thrashing West Ham 5-0 in their last league fixture. The result showed the Citizens' attacking quality and their ability to produce high-level football consistently.
 A 1-1 draw with Paris Saint-Germain in City's most recent Women's Champions League outing left qualification open. Jeglertz knows victory in Italy would give his team a significant boost in the group standings.
 With Inter eighth and Manchester City Women ninth in the Women's Champions League standings, every point matters. The team that show greater determination in Monza could make significant progress.

Before beating West Ham 5-0, the Citizens won 3-2 against Brighton and 1-2 away to London City Lionesses.
